title: Event log line (log/events.jsonl)
description: One JSON object per line, append-only. Lets an AI reconstruct what the learner clicked and answered.

type.description: Dotted name, e.g. topic.add, question.add, sheet.add, material.add, dojo.add, dojo.drills.add (new content; with subject), sheet.status, topic.status, topic.due, topic.review, openItem.done, check.done, quiz.start, quiz.answer, quiz.graded, quiz.gradeLater, quiz.applied, dojo.task, dojo.drill.start, dojo.drill.round, dojo.applied, ai.sync (the AI processed all results before it), dojo.answer, dojo.check, dojo.hint, dojo.solution, ai.request, ai.response, pack.import.

ref.description: Id of the affected topic, sheet, session, request, ...
